en_title: New Look at Avengers: Doomsday to Premiere During MLB World Series
cn_title: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》新预告将亮相MLB世界大赛
subtitle: 世界大赛抢先看
opus_summary: MLB确认，《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》全新独家预告将在世界大赛首场比赛期间播出，具体时间尚未公布。影片将于12月18日上映，并可能围绕毁灭博士引发的宇宙入侵事件展开。

paragraphs.en: A brand new preview for Avengers: Doomsday will debut during the MLB World Series.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》的全新预告将在MLB世界大赛期间首播。

paragraphs.en: The news was confirmed by the MLB itself, which noted that the exclusive sneak peek will drop during game one of the World Series. The game, which will be played by the Tampa Bay Rays and the Milwaukee Brewers, will begin tomorrow, Friday, October 23 at 8PM eastern time. They didn't give an exact time for when this preview will happen, but it wouldn't be surprising if it takes place later in the game to keep viewers watching.
paragraphs.cn: MLB确认，这段独家预告将在世界大赛首场比赛期间播出。比赛由坦帕湾光芒队对阵密尔沃基酿酒人队，将于当地时间10月23日（周五）晚8点（北京时间10月24日早8点）开始。官方没有公布预告的具体播出时间，但为了留住观众，预告若在比赛后段亮相也并不令人意外。

paragraphs.en: Tune in to World Series Game 1 for an exclusive preview of Avengers: Doomsday
paragraphs.cn: 锁定世界大赛首场比赛，观看《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》独家预告。
影片将于12月18日在全球院线上映。https://t.co/Uaj1aUbhAU

paragraphs.en: With that said, you can expect that this preview will likely also be released online, either through official Marvel channels or from a fan reupload. It's unclear if this is a brand-new trailer or an extended clip from the film. So far, we've gotten two trailers for Avengers: Doomsday, which have shown off the expansive cast of heroes battling Doctor Doom. We don't actually know a whole lot about the plot of the film, as Marvel has managed to keep things heavily under wraps. It's expected that Doom will cause an incursion event, which causes two different universes to collide in a catastrophic fashion.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，这段预告很可能也会在网上发布，来源可能是漫威官方渠道，也可能是粉丝重新上传的版本。目前还不清楚它究竟是全新预告片，还是电影中的加长片段。到目前为止，我们已经看过两支《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》预告片，其中展现了规模庞大的英雄阵容与毁灭博士交战的场面。漫威一直对影片剧情守口如瓶，因此我们其实还不太了解故事内容。预计毁灭博士会引发「宇宙入侵」事件，导致两个不同宇宙以灾难性的方式发生碰撞。

paragraphs.en: The recent re-release of Avengers: Endgame also included new scenes , which tease some events for Doomsday. At the end of the re-release, Hulk is abducted by Doctor Doom and the TVA begin to witness the multiverse falling apart via incursions. The stakes are arguably the highest they have ever been in the Marvel universe, which should lead to a very dramatic adventure.
paragraphs.cn: 最近重新上映的《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》也加入了暗示《毁灭之日》部分事件的新场景。在重映版结尾，浩克被毁灭博士绑架，TVA开始目睹多元宇宙因宇宙入侵而逐渐崩溃。漫威宇宙面临的危机或许达到了前所未有的程度，这应该会带来一场极具戏剧性的冒险。

paragraphs.en: This new look should hopefully paint a better picture of what fans can expect when the film hits theaters. We are currently just two months away from the release of Avengers: Doomsday, which will also debut the same day as Dune Part 3. The two films are expected to duke it out at the box office, with Dune having the benefit of exclusive IMAX screens. There has been some speculation that Doomsday may get an IMAX release later , not unlike Spider-Man: Brand New Day. The film is expected to get an IMAX release in China, so there will be a version for Marvel to release in other territories if it so chooses.
paragraphs.cn: 希望这次的新内容能让影迷更清楚地了解影片上映后将呈现什么。距离《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》上映目前只剩两个月，而它将与《Dune Part 3》在同一天上映。两部电影预计将在票房市场正面交锋，《Dune Part 3》则拥有独家IMAX影厅这一优势。有人猜测，《毁灭之日》之后可能会像《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》一样获得IMAX版本。影片预计会在中国上映IMAX版本，因此如果漫威愿意，也能将这一版本带到其他地区。

paragraphs.en: Avengers: Doomsday is also expected to be the first of a two-part story, like Infinity War and Endgame. Avengers: Secret Wars is currently slated to release next December, though some fear it may be delayed, as production reportedly hasn't even properly begun . It's believed that Secret Wars will also make room for some other characters not featured in Doomsday, with some speculating that Star-Lord may make his grand return following recent comments from Chris Pratt . We'll just have to wait and see what happens, though.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》预计也将是一个两部曲故事的上篇，类似《复仇者联盟3：无限战争》和《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》。目前，《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》暂定于明年12月上映，但有人担心影片可能延期，因为据报道，制作甚至还没有真正开始。据认为，《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》还将为一些没有出现在《毁灭之日》中的角色留出空间，也有人猜测，星爵可能会在Chris Pratt近期发表相关言论后盛大回归。不过，具体情况还要等着看。

paragraphs.en: Avengers: Doomsday will hit theaters on December 18.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》将于12月18日登陆院线。
